_doc: Wilderness set pieces, round 3 (agent X): Camp Tamarack, Elk Ridge Lodge, the Cordon quarantine camp and the Haldane Place, the dungeons random worlds place outside towns. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_wild3.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn|_destroyed].glb; catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_wild3.py; materials game/data/materials/props_wild3.json; the w3_signs lettering atlas textures/gen/wild3.py. size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z); PoiBuilder's collision box is the size centred over the origin. Shells (w3_*_shell) wrap a POI's kit rooms: origin at the rooms' plan centre on the ground (place them y = -floor_height); the catalog's SHELLS lists the rooms and openings they are cut for. Wall props hang with their origin on the wall plane; ceiling props hang from it.

defs.name: Camp Gate Arch
defs.description: Two bark-on posts and a log beam over the drive, the routed cedar sign CAMP TAMARACK hung under it on chains and a small cross on the beam.

defs.name: Canoe Rack
defs.description: Two H-frames of peeled poles with three canoes keel-up on the rungs (destroyed: a frame down and a canoe stove in on the ground).

defs.name: Camp Bunk
defs.description: A camp double bunk of painted 2x4s and plywood, thin striped mattresses, a sleeping bag below and a quilt above, a ladder at the foot.

defs.name: Plaque: Loon
defs.description: A routed cedar plaque, LOON, screwed beside a door (hang it ~2 m up on an outside wall).

defs.name: Plaque: Heron
defs.description: A routed cedar plaque, HERON, screwed beside a door (hang it ~2 m up on an outside wall).

defs.name: Plaque: Osprey
defs.description: A routed cedar plaque, OSPREY, screwed beside a door (hang it ~2 m up on an outside wall).

defs.description: A routed cedar plaque, KESTREL, screwed beside a door (hang it ~2 m up on an outside wall).

defs.name: Plaque: Mess Hall
defs.description: A routed cedar plaque, MESS HALL, screwed beside a door (hang it ~2 m up on an outside wall).

defs.name: Plaque: Staff Lodge
defs.description: A routed cedar plaque, STAFF LODGE, screwed beside a door (hang it ~2 m up on an outside wall).

defs.description: A routed cedar plaque, INFIRMARY, screwed beside a door (hang it ~2 m up on an outside wall).

defs.name: Plaque: Canoes
defs.description: A routed cedar plaque, CANOES, screwed beside a door (hang it ~2 m up on an outside wall).

defs.name: Family Registration Board
defs.description: The Cordon's board at the evacuation point: a blue FAMILY EVACUATION POINT 6 header, typed lists of families, cabins and convoys, snapshots and notes pinned to cork, a clipboard and a pen on a string, under a tin hood.

defs.name: Log Bench
defs.description: A split-log bench on two stumps, flat side up.

defs.name: Birch Cross
defs.description: A rough cross of peeled logs lashed together on a cairn of river stones by the water (worn: ribbons tied to its arm).

defs.name: Log Lodge Walls
defs.description: Chinked bark-on log walls, saddle-notched at the corners, two storeys round Elk Ridge Lodge's kit rooms (16 x 10 m), cut for its doors and windows; the kit roof sits on it (shell: origin at the rooms' plan centre on the ground, place it y = -floor_height).

defs.name: Fieldstone Fireplace
defs.description: A fieldstone fireplace and its breast rising 5.6 m: a raised granite hearth, a deep sooted firebox with andirons and split logs, a log mantel (place it against a wall: its back meets the wall).

defs.name: Fieldstone Chimney
defs.description: The lodge's outside chimney stack: a broad fieldstone base, stepped shoulders, the stack past the ridge, a cap slab (stands against a wall, origin on the wall plane, front away from it).

defs.name: Antler Chandelier
defs.description: Shed antlers wired round a wrought-iron hoop on a long chain, eight candles in cups (ceiling-mounted: origin on the ceiling, it hangs 2.6 m: for tall rooms).

defs.name: Lodge Sign
defs.description: ELK RIDGE LODGE routed into a cedar board between two bark-on posts, a rack of antlers over it.

defs.name: Kennel Board
defs.description: The hounds' names on a board on a stake: BELLE, DUKE, ROSIE, JACK.

defs.name: Elk Mount
defs.description: A bull elk's head on an oak shield, six points a side (worn: a glass eye gone, a tine broken). Place it against a wall with a y: its back meets the wall.

defs.name: Buck Mount
defs.description: A whitetail buck's head on an oak shield, four points a side. Place it against a wall with a y.

defs.name: Bearskin Rug
defs.description: A black bear's hide spread on the floor, its head mounted at one end, mouth open.

defs.name: Gun Cabinet
defs.description: A glass-fronted oak gun cabinet: rifles in a notched rack on green felt, drawers under them (destroyed: glass out, the rack bare).

defs.name: Skinning Gambrel
defs.description: Two pole A-frames and a cross pole, a chain and a steel gambrel, an elk carcass hung by its hind legs with the hide peeled to the shoulders over a tub (worn: gone dark, pale threads in it).

defs.name: Kennel Run
defs.description: A 2 x 4 m dog run of galvanized pipe and chain-link with a plywood doghouse, a bowl and a chain (worn: a panel pushed out where they dug and the gate open; destroyed: a side flattened).

defs.name: Meat Rail
defs.description: Two steel posts and a rail with S-hooks, elk quarters hung over a drip pan (worn: black and furred with pale threads).

defs.name: Ward Tent
defs.description: An open-sided olive ward tent, 5 x 9.6 m: three centre poles, the walls rolled up on their ties, guy lines to stakes (no collision: walk in under the eaves; destroyed: half of it fallen in).

defs.name: Restraint Cot
defs.description: A Cordon field cot, olive canvas on an aluminium frame, two restraint straps across it, a grey blanket and a wristband tag on the foot bar.

defs.name: Decontamination Shower
defs.description: A PVC shower frame with four spray heads, white curtains on two sides, a pallet floor over a catch basin, the feed hose and the yellow 2 SHOWER sign.

defs.name: Light Tower
defs.description: A towable light tower: a generator box on a two-wheel trailer with outrigger jacks and a three-stage mast to 7 m carrying four floodlights.

defs.name: Cordon Fence
defs.description: Three metres of the camp's fence: chain-link on galvanized posts with a white privacy screen, barbed wire and a concertina coil on outriggers leaning out (+Z is inside; destroyed: cut and peeled back).

defs.name: Cordon Gate
defs.description: The camp's double gate chained shut, the QUARANTINE notice on one leaf, the STOP / CHECKPOINT sign on its post.

defs.name: Sandbag Wall
defs.description: Two metres of sandbag wall three courses high (worn: bags slumped and split).

defs.name: Watchtower
defs.description: A scaffold watchtower: four braced legs, a plank deck at 4.2 m behind sandbags, a tarp roof, a ladder and a searchlight.

defs.name: Morgue Reefer
defs.description: A refrigerated semi-trailer body round the morgue's kit room (3 x 8 m): white ribbed walls, the reefer unit on its front, rear doors swung back, sat on railway-tie cribbing, MORGUE stencilled on its sides (shell: origin at the room's plan centre on the ground, place it y = -floor_height).

defs.name: Command Trailer
defs.description: A white site-office trailer round the command post's kit rooms (4 x 9 m): ribbed walls on a plywood skirt, an antenna mast, steps to the door, CORDON COMMAND - UNIT 4 on its sides (shell: origin at the rooms' plan centre on the ground, place it y = -floor_height).

defs.name: Body Bag
defs.description: A zipped body bag lying flat, the shape of someone inside (clean: the Cordon's white bags; worn: black).

defs.name: Morgue Rack
defs.description: Steel shelving, three shelves, body bags on the lower two.

defs.name: Ward Marker A
defs.description: An olive board stencilled A on a stake by a ward tent's door.

defs.name: Ward Marker B
defs.description: An olive board stencilled B on a stake by a ward tent's door.

defs.name: Ward Marker C
defs.description: An olive board stencilled C on a stake by a ward tent's door.

defs.name: Ward Marker D
defs.description: An olive board stencilled D on a stake by a ward tent's door.

defs.name: Scrap Wall
defs.description: Two metres of a homestead's wall: bark-on posts and rails clad with whatever they had - corrugated sheets, pallets, plywood, a car door - barbed wire along the top (outside is +Z's back, -Z; destroyed: sheets torn off, a post leaning).

defs.name: Scrap Gate
defs.description: A gate of pallets and corrugated tin on a pole frame between two heavy posts, chained, TURN BACK painted on a board over it.

defs.name: Watch Platform
defs.description: A platform on four posts, its plank deck at 2.4 m behind a plywood-and-tin parapet, a ladder, a tarp over a pole, a can of spent shells.

defs.name: Raised Garden Bed
defs.description: A raised bed of rough planks, 1.2 x 3 m, kale and cabbage in rows (worn: bolted and yellowing; destroyed: trampled and spilled).

defs.name: Rain Catcher
defs.description: A blue tarp sagged into a funnel on four poles over a blue drum with a tap.

defs.name: Stake Row
defs.description: Sharpened stakes driven through a log, angled out at chest height.

defs.name: Downed Power Pole
defs.description: A creosoted power pole down across the ground, its crossarm askew and a cut line looped off it in the grass.

defs.name: Tarp Lean-to
defs.description: A blue tarp strung lean-to fashion from the side of a truck to two peeled poles, guyed out to stakes.
